title: You Think Kids Need Rewards to Learn, Yet Your Brain Copies What It Sees With Zero Prize
description:
You think kids only learn habits when rewarded! Yet silent watching rewires their moves with no prize! This is the true story of Albert Bandura's Bobo doll. Here is what went wrong with old reward rules.
